source: LongDA (arXiv:2601.02598), survey NSCG. Underlying microdata: NSF NCSES 2023 National Survey of College Graduates public-use file (published reference NSF 25-331). Gold from LongDA benchmark.csv and reproduced exactly from the microdata by truth/solution.py.
answer_structure: [size10, size11_24, size25_99, size100_499, size500_999, size1000_4999, size5000plus]

checkpoints.telework_column: TELEC (telework status); teleworker = code 4 'allowed to telework and did'
checkpoints.employer_size_column: EMSIZE (codes 1-8); buckets 7 (5000-24999) and 8 (25000+) merge into size5000plus
checkpoints.statistic: weighted count in thousands = sum(WTSURVY for TELEC=4) / 1000 per employer-size bucket

decoys.include_required_TELEC3: adding the 'required to telework' category (code 3) inflates every bucket
decoys.all_eight_size_codes: reporting 8 buckets (not merging 5000-24999 with 25000+) yields a mismatched-length answer
decoys.unweighted_counts: counting rows instead of summing WTSURVY gives the unweighted column, not population thousands
decoys.forget_thousands: summing weights without dividing by 1000 overstates by ~1000x
